Plot daily activity as a serpentine timeline of days

Source: R/activity_snake.R
activity_snake.Rd

An activity snake shows when events occur over many days. Each day is a band spanning the same time-of-day window, and consecutive days are joined by U-turns, so a long run of days fits in one panel while their order is kept. Events appear as thin ticks (instantaneous events) or as blocks whose width is the event's duration, which places daily rhythms, gaps and irregular days side by side for comparison.

activity_snake() takes event times as a vector of timestamps, a data frame of timestamps, or a data frame of day, start time and duration. It draws one band per day on a dark ribbon, with hourly gridlines, an hour axis, day labels carrying the day's total duration or number of events, and the clock time at each U-turn. Bands can alternate direction (flow = "snake") so that time runs on through each U-turn, or all read in the same direction (flow = "natural"); the layout can be horizontal or vertical.

The display encodes the timing of events, not their values. For a continuous measurement through the day use line_snake(); for a sequence of categorical states use sequence_snake(); for ratings collected at each prompt use the var/day interface of survey_snake(). facet_snake() draws one activity snake per group.

Usage

activity_snake(
  data,
  band_height = 28,
  band_gap = 18,
  day_start = 360,
  day_end = 1440,
  plot_width = 500,
  band_color = "#3d3d4a",
  event_color = "#d4a843",
  arc_color = "#2a2a3a",
  band_opacity = 0.9,
  arc_opacity = 0.85,
  event_opacity = 0.85,
  tick_width = 1.5,
  show_grid = TRUE,
  show_total = TRUE,
  show_count = FALSE,
  show_hour_labels = TRUE,
  show_arc_labels = TRUE,
  shadow = TRUE,
  grid_color = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)",
  label_color = "#cccccc",
  label_size = 0.85,
  label_align = "left",
  orientation = c("horizontal", "vertical"),
  start_from = c("left", "right"),
  flow = c("snake", "natural"),
  day_format = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  margin = c(top = 30, right = 10, bottom = 50, left = 80),
  background = "white"
)

Arguments

data

Events, in one of three forms:

  • a POSIXct vector of event times;

  • a data frame with a POSIXct timestamp or start column, and optionally an end column (POSIXct) or a duration column (minutes);

  • a data frame with columns day (day label), start (minutes after midnight, 0-1440) and duration (minutes; 0 for an instantaneous event).

Column names are matched without regard to case, and common variants such as start_time, end_time or date are recognised. Character timestamps are parsed. Days appear in order of first occurrence.

band_height, band_gap

Height of each day band and gap between bands, in plot units (defaults 28 and 18).

day_start, day_end

Time window of each band, in minutes after midnight (defaults 360, 6 AM, and 1440, midnight). When data is a POSIXct vector, or a data frame whose timestamp or start column is POSIXct, the window is widened to whole hours covering all events.

plot_width

Length of each band in plot units (default 500).

band_color, event_color

Colors of the bands and of the events (defaults "#3d3d4a" and "#d4a843"). A vector of colors is recycled over days.

arc_color

Color of the U-turns (default "#2a2a3a").

band_opacity, arc_opacity, event_opacity

Opacities between 0 and 1 (defaults 0.90, 0.85 and 0.85).

tick_width

Minimum width of an event in plot units (default 1.5), which keeps instantaneous events visible.

show_grid

Draw hourly gridlines (default TRUE).

show_total

Append the day's total event duration to its label (default TRUE).

show_count

Append the day's number of events to its label (default FALSE).

show_hour_labels

Draw the hour axis (default TRUE).

show_arc_labels

Print the clock time at each U-turn (default TRUE).

shadow

Draw drop shadows (default TRUE).

grid_color

Gridline color: an R color or a CSS-style "rgba(r,g,b,a)" string (default "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)").

label_color, label_size

Color and size multiplier of the day labels (defaults "#cccccc" and 0.85).

label_align

Alignment of the day labels: "left" (default), "right", or "direction" to follow each band's reading direction.

orientation

"horizontal" (default) for bands running across the page, or "vertical" for bands running down it. The vertical layout uses smaller sizes and margins for those arguments left at their defaults.

start_from

Side on which the first band starts: "left" (default) or "right".

flow

"snake" (default): bands alternate direction, so time runs on through each U-turn. "natural": every band reads in the same direction.

day_format

strftime() format of day labels built from timestamps, such as "%a" or "%d %b". NULL (default) uses "%a" for up to seven days and "%Y-%m-%d" otherwise.

legend

Legend entries: a list of items, each a list with label and color, and optionally type ("rect", the default, "tick" or "gradient"). NULL (default) draws no legend.

title

Plot title, or NULL (default) for none.

margin

Named numeric vector of top, right, bottom and left margins in plot units (default c(top = 30, right = 10, bottom = 50, left = 80)).

background

Background color (default "white").

Value

The plot is drawn on the current device. The function returns, invisibly, an object of class snake_layout: a list describing the drawn geometry, with bands (a data frame with one row per day band giving its index, position, and drawing and reading direction), arcs (a list with one element per U-turn), canvas and plot_area (dimensions in plot units), orientation, flow and params (the sizes used).

See also

line_snake() for a continuous value through the day; sequence_snake() for categorical states; survey_snake() for ratings at each prompt; facet_snake() for one panel per group.

Examples

# One participant's 69 prompts over 14 days of experience sampling
beeps <- subset(ema_beeps, id == "xcVDLRQOwn", select = start_time)
activity_snake(beeps, show_total = FALSE, show_count = TRUE)


# Sessions with durations: day, start (minutes after midnight), length
set.seed(1)
sessions <- data.frame(
  day      = rep(c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"), each = 4),
  start    = round(runif(20, 420, 1260)),
  duration = round(runif(20, 20, 120))
)
activity_snake(sessions, event_color = "#E69F00", flow = "natural")
